# Synthetic PDF fixture

`export-preview.pdf` was generated by this repository's Python DOCX exporter and LibreOffice using the APA journal preset. Its title, abstract, equation, table, and repeated paragraphs are fictional browser-test content. It contains no uploaded manuscript or research findings.

The browser regression test renders this real PDF using the production PDF.js worker and verifies that downloading a preview returns exactly the same bytes. API integration tests independently check authentication, revision validation, and snapshot headers.
